steps.instructions: Phase 1/2 SCOPE: map the attack surface in scope: entry points and the input they take, authentication and authorization, secrets and configuration, dependencies and their versions, and the data each path can reach. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. READ-ONLY: create, edit or delete no file in any repository, commit nothing, and run no command that writes there; your output is the report.

Phase 2/2 SECURITY REVIEW (security engineer): report each vulnerability or weakness with its file:line, how it could be exploited and its severity, and the fix it needs, the most severe first. Change nothing yourself: a fix is a separate job. PASS only when every finding holds at file:line.
